svg.title: OAuth with refresh tokens
svg.desc: Your app sends an authorization grant to the authentication server, which responds with an access token and a refresh token. Later your app sends the refresh token to the authentication server and gets back a new access token, and possibly a new refresh token. To use the API, your app sends only the access token to the resource server, which responds with private data.
